title: Add per-item camera attachment with inline capture

requirements.summary: Add attach image button next to each of the 7 checklist items
acceptanceCriteria: Each checklist item displays a small attach image button
Button is positioned next to the checkbox and label
Button is touch-friendly with minimum 44px tap target

file_operations.description: Add attach image button component next to each checklist item. Position button after checkbox and label in each item's row. Use NeumorphicButton component with icon or compact text to maintain visual balance. Ensure 44px minimum tap target for mobile touch interactions. Store active camera item state to track which item's camera is open.

requirements.summary: Display inline camera interface within screen for photo capture
acceptanceCriteria: Camera interface appears inline within the main screen flow
Camera is not displayed in a popup, modal, or separate window
Camera preview is visible and functional
User can capture photo directly from this inline view

file_operations.description: Integrate inline camera view below the active checklist item when its attach button is clicked. Use the camera component's useCamera hook to support inline camera preview. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing. Ensure camera appears within the main form flow, not as a modal or popup. Display camera controls (capture, switch, close) inline with the preview. Set explicit preview dimensions to prevent layout collapse.

Update CameraCapture component to support inline rendering mode and per-item photo management. Add props for active item context and callback for photo association. Ensure camera preview has stable aspect ratio and explicit dimensions. Use the camera component's useCamera hook with environment facing mode. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing. Include capture, switch camera, and close controls inline within preview area.

requirements.summary: Associate captured photos with specific checklist items
acceptanceCriteria: Photo is linked to the correct checklist item
Visual indication shows which item has an attached photo
User can see thumbnail or confirmation of attached photo per item

file_operations.description: Maintain state mapping each checklist item to its captured photo (Map or object with item name as key, File/ExternalBlob as value). When photo is captured via camera component, store it with the active item identifier. Display thumbnail or icon indicator next to items that have attached photos. Update photo state when camera completes capture for the active item.
Update ChecklistItem interface to include optional photo property matching the backend ExternalBlob type. Maintain exported array of 7 predefined checklist item names unchanged.

requirements.summary: Update PDF generation to show photos next to corresponding checklist items
acceptanceCriteria: PDF displays each checklist item with its associated photo
Photos are properly formatted and sized within the PDF
PDF maintains store name, item statuses, and timestamp

file_operations.description: Update PDF generation function to accept array of photos mapped to checklist items. For each checklist item in the PDF, display its associated photo (if present) next to the checkbox and label. Convert photo Files or ExternalBlobs to data URLs for embedding in PDF HTML. Size photos appropriately within PDF layout. Preserve existing store name, item statuses, and timestamp display.
Pass per-item photos map to PDF generator function when generating PDF. Ensure all captured photos are included in the PDF generation call with their corresponding item identifiers.

requirements.summary: Clear all per-item photos on form reset
acceptanceCriteria: All captured photos are removed on form reset
All attach image buttons return to initial state
Camera interface is closed if open

file_operations.description: Update form reset handler to clear all per-item photos from state (empty the photos map/object). Reset any active camera item state to close inline camera if open. Return all attach image buttons to initial state without photo indicators. Ensure reset happens after successful submission.
